responsibility: Implements the shared channel-device policy engine used by gm2 ISO I/O devices. It wraps an RTgenif callback table in a ChanDev record, validates that a DeviceTable entry matches the expected device id and channel, enforces read/write and text/raw flag consistency, performs generic Look/Skip/Text/Raw operations, updates IOConsts.ReadResults from EOF/EOLN state, and translates device errno values into standardized IOLink/IOChan exceptions, so concrete devices only need to supply primitive callbacks.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the executable implementation of RTgen’s generic channel layer. Unlike RTgen.def, which only publishes the ChanDev API and procedure signatures, it defines the ChanDev record, initializes EOF-handling tables, and performs the concrete channel validation, flag enforcement, callback dispatch, and errno-to-exception mapping.
